At second 03, tension applies and individual yarn microfibers stretch taut with visible physical elongation.
Laser line sweeps across the weave, highlighting microscopic fiber textures.

scenes.omni_prose_prompt: An extreme macro 100mm camera shot frames the intricate technical fabric weave from <image_1> resting on the titanium stage of <image_2>. Filmed at 1.0x real-time speed with rigid physics, the intertwined matte-black carbon yarns and luminous cyan microfibers sit in sharp stillness for the first three seconds under deep blue lab lighting. At second 03, mechanical tension applies from the edges, causing the interlocking threads to pull taut with realistic elasticity, elongating slightly without tearing or morphing while maintaining continuous kinetic momentum conservation and tensile inertia under physical load. A crisp emerald laser scan line sweeps smoothly across the surface at second 06, catching the micro-ridges of each fiber in tack-sharp focus. Synchronized diegetic audio layers a deep, tactile microfiber stretch sound, a soft pneumatic pressure release, and high-precision electronic equipment hum.
conversational_edit_deltas: Turn 2: Add visible micro-dust particle displacement upon tension snap.

scenes.omni_prose_prompt: The camera punches in smoothly on the fabric center from the front at 1.0x real-time speed, tracking continuous kinetic momentum conservation and physical inertia until the turbines power down and elastic restoring forces bring the textile into static rest. At second 27, the wind tunnel turbines instantly power down with a solid acoustic drop: the high-speed smoke ribbons dissipate into thin air, and the flexed fabric springs crisply back to its initial flat resting plane with a singular, satisfying physical SNAP. The material settles instantly into flawless, motionless stillness, its black-and-cyan weave catching the steady ambient blue glow of the lab with razor-sharp macro clarity. Zero camera drift and zero digital artifacting. Synchronized diegetic audio captures the heavy pneumatic clunk of the wind valves closing, the crisp, singular SNAP of the taut textile rebounding, and the smooth decay of turbine whine into dead-silent lab room tone.
